found.name: Mandatory online self-pace short course on academic integrity
found.quote: All students will be required to undertake a mandatory online self-pace short course on academic integrity before they can submit their first assessment.

found.name: Student Union Advice Hub
found.quote: A student against whom an allegation has been made may wish to access support from the Student Union Advice Hub or the Student Representative Bodies for students at the Dubai and Malaysia campuses.
